correctness.rationale: Fletcher–Martin Proposition 6.3(i) identifies J(f) with the two-symbol shift times S² and the angular maps descend from y->dy and y->m(y1,-y2) on R²/(2Z) with pillow involution y~-y. A word w with r inner branches gives A=Q diag(1,(-1)^r), Q=d^{n-r}m^r. Pillow fixed classes are (ker(A-I) union ker(A+I))/+-; Burnside gives half the sum of determinant moduli, Q²+(-1)^r. Sum over binomially many words cancels sign for n>=1 giving D^n. Original Theorem 1.1/6.1 implies only infinity adds an extra periodic Fatou point, so total D^n+1 and the stated rational Artin-Mazur zeta. Independently enumerated torus pillow classes Q=3: 10 orientation preserving, 8 reflection, and n=3 d=2 m=3 weighted sum 13³. The global conjugacy is an inspected published premise, not re-proved by this audit.
